method: All assembled pairs checked as OCC solids. Dense motion/separation: 0.002 mm absolute / 0.04 rad CAD tessellation, FCL triangle candidates confirmed by OCC intersections. Five mesh poses use full OCC intersections. Sampled checks, not continuous collision proof or FEA.
limits: Axial fit allowance is 0.3 mm; printed endplay and motor axial load capacity require physical testing
No load, wear, efficiency, thermal, self-locking, thrust-bearing life or motor-torque validation
Staged drive disassembly; motor and worm form a removable subassembly
Nominal command increments are not measured accuracy

flexure_clearance.blend_radius_reference: Unloaded print geometry; the rounded profiles deform with the prescribed leaf displacement.
flexure_clearance.method: Independent spring solids including actual rounded transitions versus added worm supports, fixed chassis outside the intentional root, tray and cover. Conservative bounding envelopes clear the prescribed spring travel; OCC checks sample at 0.1 mm. Minimum leaf thickness is retained. Prescribed shapes are not an elastic simulation.

motor_mount_reinforcement.design: Two deep longitudinal webs join the motor faceplate to the rear bridge and existing support floor, with tangent roots. Existing motor, guide, flexure and fastener clearances are retained.
motor_mount_reinforcement.mechanical_validation: Geometry only; no stiffness, stress or fatigue rating. Physical print/load testing required.

marked_motor_bridges.design: One face-aligned U flange with a shared top plane, motor-plate cap, inward-set rails, rounded opening and smoothly flared shoulders. Marked coordinates identify regions only.

motor_bolt_insertion.method: Exact continuous swept shaft and head solids for each axis-aligned segment, against the assembly at that stage. Insertion reverses the same collision-checked path. Socket recesses conservatively treated as solid.

motor_bolt_tool_access.configuration: Upper bolts from above with cover and rack removed; lower bolts from underneath. Motor/chassis remain installed. Compact 2.5 mm hex key, 8 mm short-leg reach and 40 mm long leg.

guide_contact_acceleration: Exact rack clipping to Y=13..213, Z=-187..13; every guide bearing bounding box, including spring lift, is asserted inside it. This preserves solid intersection volumes.

bearing_axial_capture.note: Geometric capture, not a preload or bearing-life calculation; check actual endplay after printing.

mounting.note: Enclosure bounds, mounting-hole centers and face planes match the enclosed spur actuator. Flat cover. Motor body projects through the rear aperture; allow room for its exposed back and controller.

enclosure.tool_access_configuration: M3 set screw on motor/worm subassembly outside housing; front M5 bolt through enclosure service port

end_bearing_installation.configuration: insert bearing from +X into chassis outside enclosure, then lower chassis into tray

chassis_installation.configuration: bare unloaded chassis; rack, motor, guide hardware and cover installed afterward

guide_hardware_access.configuration: unloaded chassis outside enclosure; nuts and lower bearings first, then axles and upper rollers

guided_chassis_installation.configuration: unloaded chassis with seven bearings and guide axle hardware; motor, worm, rack and cover absent

limits: Geometric fit and clearance checks only; no load rating or printed strength test.
NEMA17 four-hole interface; no motor pilot or shaft bore is added.
End plate protrudes beyond both rack printing faces; support is needed if printing on a long face.

sweep.method: Continuous conservative AABB separation for full stroke and each piecewise-linear assembly interval; rotation envelopes and all available chassis spring meshes included.
